author: Chase Davis
title: Jac Caglianone clubs HR, drives in two in 6-5 win
desc: Jac Caglianone went 2-for-4 in a 6-5 win over the Cardinals with a home run, two runs scored, two RBI and one strikeout.
impact: After Friday's win, Caglianone is batting .270 with 10 home runs, 24 RBI, 32 runs scored and three stolen bases across 71 games. That makes back-to-back games with a homer and two RBI, and a .365 batting average through June. He's started five of six games at first base since Vinnie Pasquantino landed on the IL.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Denzer Guzman homers in loss to Athletics
desc: Denzer Guzman went 1-for-5 in a loss to the Athletics with a two-run home run.
impact: Guzman has heated up at the plate since being called up, picking up hits in seven of his last eight contests. The 22-year-old has been one of many streaky options in the Angels lineup for manager Kurt Suzuki, batting .244 with one home run, seven RBI, four runs scored, and one stolen base through 10 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Alex Lange converts fifth save vs Cards
desc: Alex Lange got the last out of the game to record his fifth save in the 6-5 win over the Cardinals.
impact: After the save, Lange has a 3.97 ERA, 1.41 WHIP, 9.3 K/9, one hold and five saves in 32 appearances. It's good to see him bounce back after allowing runs in two of his last three appearances. He seems like the guy in Kansas City.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Nolan Schanuel homers in loss to Athletics
desc: Nolan Schanuel went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Athletics with a solo home run, one walk, and two runs scored.
impact: Schanuel continues to underperform at the plate of late, picking up hits in four of his last 10 contests. The 24-year-old remains one of many inconsistent bats in a disappointing Angels lineup, slashing .253 with five home runs, 26 RBI, and 23 runs scored across 59 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Zach Neto goes deep in loss to A's
desc: Zach Neto went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Athletics with a solo home run and one walk.
impact: Neto has flashed his power stroke at the plate of late, homering in three of his last four contests. The shortstop remains one of many underperforming bats in the Angels lineup, batting .225 with 16 home runs, 35 RBI, 52 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases across 74 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Seth Lugo grinds out win despite zero Ks
desc: Seth Lugo allowed one earned run on five hits and three walks while striking out zero over six innings in Friday's win over the Cardinals.
impact: After the win, Lugo now owns a 3-4 record with a 3.69 ERA and 1.35 WHIP across 15 starts. While he completed his ninth quality start, the strikeouts were lacking for the second consecutive outing. He gave up nine hard hits and picked up just four whiffs on 85 pitches. He gets the Tampa Bay Rays next.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jose Soriano struggles with command against A's
desc: Jose Soriano allowed four earned runs on six hits and four walks while striking out six over five innings in Friday's loss to the Athletics.
impact: Soriano has provided mixed results on the mound of late, allowing three earned runs or more in four of his last eight trips to the mound. The right-hander remains one of the more stable starting options as part of a disappointing Angels rotation, carrying a 3.03 ERA and 1.27 WHIP with an 8-4 record and 9.6 K/9 ratio across 16 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Lawrence Butler goes yard, steals base in win over Angels
desc: Lawrence Butler went 2-for-4 in a win over the Angels with a solo home run, one walk, one stolen base, and four runs scored.
impact: Butler has heated up at the plate, picking up hits in six of his last eight contests. The outfielder remains one of the more disappointing options in the Athletics lineup to this point, slashing .193 with five home runs, 20 RBI, 26 runs scored, and five stolen bases across 68 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jacob Wilson goes deep in slugfest win over Angels
desc: Jacob Wilson went 2-for-5 in a win over the Angels with a home run, a double, one run scored, and three RBI.
impact: Wilson has caught fire since returning to the lineup, reaching base in each of his last seven contests. The 24-year-old remains one of the more reliable bats in the Athletics lineup with injuries in the rearview mirror, slashing .287 with four homers, 26 RBI, 22 runs scored, and two steals across 46 games

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jonah Heim belts game-tying homer in win over Angels
desc: Jonah Heim went 1-for-1 in a win over the Angels with a pinch-hit, two-run home run.
impact: Heim has heated up at the plate, picking up hits in seven of his last eight contests. The 30-year-old continues to flash a productive bat as another streaky option in the Athletics lineup, batting .260 with six home runs, 16 RBI, and 14 runs scored across 33 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jeffrey Springs shelled early in abbreviated outing against Angels
desc: Jeffrey Springs allowed six earned runs on four hits and four walks while striking out four over 3 2/3 innings in Friday's win over the Angels.
impact: Springs has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing four earned runs or more in each of his last four starts. The left-hander cannot be trusted as a starting option as part of a frustrating Athletics rotation, posting a 5.55 ERA and 1.35 WHIP with a 3-7 record and 7.8 K/9 ratio across 16 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Henry Bolte swipes base in win over Angels
desc: Henry Bolte went 1-for-2 in a win over the Angels with three walks and one stolen base.
impact: Bolte continues a scorching stretch at the plate, collecting hits in 10 of his last 11 contests. The 22-year-old continues to find ways to offer manager Mark Kotsay an impactful option in a streaky Athletics lineup, batting .317 with two home runs, 11 runs scored, nine RBI and seven stolen bases across 34 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Max Muncy clubs homer in win over Angels
desc: Max Muncy went 1-for-3 in a win over the Angels with a two-run home run.
impact: Muncy has provided mixed results at the plate of late, picking up hits in four of his last eight contests. The 23-year-old has struggled with consistency issues at the plate for manager Mark Kotsay, slashing .235 with four home runs, 16 RBI, 19 runs scored, and two stolen bases across 34 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tyler Soderstrom racks up three hits in win over Angels
desc: Tyler Soderstrom went 3-for-3 in a win over the Angles with a double, two walks, and three runs scored.
impact: Soderstrom has heated up at the plate of late, registering hits in five of his last seven contests. The 24-year-old remains one of streaky options in the Athletics lineup for manager Mark Kotsay, batting .243 with 13 home runs, 40 RBI, 39 runs scored, and one stolen base across 73 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tatsuya Imai misses bats in win over Guardians
desc: Tatsuya Imai allowed three earned runs on six hits while striking out 11 over six innings in Friday's win over the Guardians.
impact: Imai has provided mixed results on the mound of late, allowing three earned runs or more in three of his last six trips to the mound. The right-hander remains a high-risk starting option in the Astros rotation for manager Joe Espada, posting a 6.15 ERA and 1.44 WHIP to go with a 4-3 record and 2.0 K/BB ratio across 10 starts.
